name: qkd_kvs_grp_r2db-r2db-COMMIT
purpose: KDIE5-RTL 10-22: pin-registered successor of qkd_kvs_grp for the release KV die (FB)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_kvs_grp_r2d u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_die_20261017/qkd_kvs_grp_r2d.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_kvs_grp_r2db/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_kvs_grp_r2db/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_kvs_grp_r2db --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_kvs_grp_r2d --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: KDIE5-RTL2 10-22: top qkd_kvs_grp_r2d = qkd_kvs_grp_r2c + one exit flop copy per additional output word sharing an r2c exit flop (krsp vs rsp 1056 bits, o_pc1..3 vs o_pc0 56 bits each; kv_grp_portcopy.py, 0 edges): r2c gate d957 placement reg->out rsp[37] -714 ps / grp_h krsp[944] -1638 ps = one flop fixed at one pin driving a second pin ~0.5-1 mm away. KDIE5-RTL 10-22: top qkd_kvs_grp_r2c = bounded-driver structural copy (kv_grp_safe5.py, max 32 loads) of the ORFS mapped netlist of qkd_kvs_grp_r2 = the UNCHANGED release module qkd_kvs_grp (n32_pj) as u_core + face registers: no combinational in -> out path (o_dn 4 edges a hop, in-tile equalising delay so every group sees the fan word +29, gather own +3 / +4 a hop, cf1 fault inputs +2, EST / tok / tep +2). Frame, pins, macros, spine, reset landing = qkd_kvs_grp_r1. FB: fan / gather relay stages FIRM at their 1/3 / 2/3 span points (relay_place.tcl).
